text.brief: A compliance officer at a Hong Kong private bank approves her fortieth transfer of the week to Singapore and Dubai in 2040. Each client sits on a provincial Party committee, and each one wires the maximum.
text.record: Mainland visitors bought HK$62.8 billion of new Hong Kong insurance policies in 2024, 28.6 percent of new individual business. Hong Kong's Insurance Authority has published no separate figure for mainland visitors since early 2025. Britain has granted well over 100,000 visas to Hong Kongers with British National (Overseas) status since 2021.
text.reading: When all else fails, the Party's elites retreat with their fortunes. Hong Kong becomes the exit, and money taken from the Chinese people funds each faction's life abroad. This is Stratagem 36, if all else fails, retreat.
text.coreEvent: More than $500 billion of private wealth leaves the mainland through Hong Kong within two years of a succession crisis before 2046.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. Western banks treat officials' wealth as private money until a court says otherwise.
text.fix: Trace the wealth of senior Party officials before it moves, and hold it for the people it came from.
